title: Club Membership: employer-funded reduction of the enrollment fee
content:
## Scope
This document states, for the Club Membership enrollment fee charge, the basis on which an employer-linked benefit reduces the amount billed.

## Rule
Where the member is the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, the enrollment fee charge is reduced by that linked employer partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same employer partnership tier's own multi-location discount percentage. Where no active corporate wellness enrollment links to the member, no reduction of this kind applies.

## Condition table
| Member's corporate wellness enrollment | Reduction basis applied |
|---|---|
| Linked and active | Employer partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same tier's own multi-location discount percentage |
| Linked but not active | None |
| No linked enrollment | None |

## Points of judgement
A member who was once linked to a corporate wellness enrollment that has since lapsed out of active status is, for this reduction, in the same position as a member with no linked enrollment at all: no reduction of this kind applies until the enrollment is active again.
